name: Create a finding instances export
description: Create a finding instances export Creates a CSV export for Finding instances and accepts optional filters in the payload. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/data-security/posture/findings/{storage_namespace_id}/instances/export
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/data-security/posture/findings/{storage_namespace_id}/instances/export
Creates a CSV export for Finding instances and accepts optional filters in the payload. The `storage_namespace_id` path parameter is derived from the finding ID by base64-decoding it (which yields `integration_id:finding_type_id`) and replacing the colon with a hyphen.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID for the user making the request.; storage_namespace_id (path) — A storage namespace identifier for the finding, used to scope finding instance exports. Constructed by base64-decoding the finding ID (which encodes `integration_id:finding_type_id`) and replacing the colon separator with a hyphen. For example, a finding ID that decodes to `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002` becomes `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002`.
Optional: body (body)

This allows customers to verify their webhook endpoint is still reachable and properly configured after creating the webhook resource. name: List instances of a finding
description: List instances of a finding Lists all security finding instances for a given security finding. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/data-security/posture/findings/{finding_id}/instances
context:

Lists all security finding instances for a given security finding.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID for the user making the request.; finding_id (path) — A base64-encoded ID identifying this Finding.
Optional: archived (query) — Archived; cursor (query) — A cursor for pagination. Obtained from the `result_info.cursor` field of a previous response.; direction (query) — Direction to order results.; max_affliction_date (query) — Filter to view findings that occurred on or before the affliction date. Can be a date-time in ISO 8601 format or an epoch timestamp.; min_affliction_date (query) — Filter to view findings that occurred on or after the affliction date. Can be a date-time in ISO 8601 format or an epoch timestamp.; order (query) — Which field to use when ordering the Finding's instances. When ordering by 'remediation.status', only the most recent non-stale remediation job is considered. Stale jobs (created before the instance's affliction_date) are treated as having no status for ordering purposes.; page (query) — A page number within the paginated result set.; per_page (query) — Number of results to return per page.; search (query) — A search term.; remediation_statuses (query) — Filter finding instances by most recent remediation job status. Supports multiple comma-separated values. Use 'none' to filter instances with no remediation jobs or instances where the most recent job is stale. Note: Stale jobs (created before the instance's affliction_date) are ignored for filtering purposes, but are still included in the 'remediations' array with stale=true.; finding_instance_ids (query) — Filter finding instances by an array of finding instance IDs. Supports multiple comma-separated values.; asset_ids (query) — Filter finding instances by an array of asset IDs. Supports multiple comma-separated values.

name: List policy invocation logs
description: List policy invocation logs Returns a list of policy invocation logs for the given account, sourced from ClickHouse via Ready Analytics. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/data-security/posture/policies/logs
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/data-security/posture/policies/logs
Returns a list of policy invocation logs for the given account, sourced from ClickHouse via Ready Analytics. Each entry represents one execution of a policy against a finding instance, including the actions (remediation jobs and webhooks) it dispatched. Results are scoped to the requesting account's CASB integrations. The `integration_id` query parameter, when supplied, is intersected against the account's integration allowlist; values outside the allowlist are silently dropped. Pagination is offset-based. The response does not include a total row count; clients should treat a result with fewer than `per_page` entries as the end of the list.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID for the user making the request.
Optional: since (query) — Lower bound on the log entry timestamp. Accepts ISO 8601 / RFC3339 or epoch seconds. Defaults to 7 days before `until`. The window between `since` and `until` cannot exceed 180 days.; until (query) — Upper bound on the log entry timestamp. Accepts ISO 8601 / RFC3339 or epoch seconds. Defaults to the current time. Must be greater than or equal to `since`.; integration_id (query) — Comma-separated list of CASB integration IDs to filter by. At most 100 values, each at most 128 characters. Values outside the account's tenancy allowlist are silently ignored. When omitted, results are scoped to the full allowlist.; policy_name (query) — Comma-separated list of policy display names to filter by. At most 100 values, each at most 255 characters.; page (query) — A page number within the paginated result set.; per_page (query) — Number of results to return per page.

Supports multiple comma-separated values.; integration_id (query) — Filter by an integration ID; order (query) — An optional param to sort the results by the given field.; direction (query) — Direction to order results.
